reading.title: Preparing Mona’s room
reading.text: Adult friends prepare Mona’s birthday room. A balloon stands near the door, with a banner and streamer above it. Salma spreads a tablecloth, places a party hat at each seat and adds a little confetti away from food. A centerpiece stands in the middle, and a garland crosses the wall. An unopened piñata is displayed as a decoration. Bunting hangs above the large cake and individual cupcakes. Pizza comes first, with ice cream and candy among the desserts. The hosts ask about preferences rather than guessing ingredients from pictures. Nobody must wear a hat or choose a particular food to join the celebration.

reading.title: Choosing activities
reading.text: At the adult party, popcorn, a juice box and homemade lemonade are available. Fruit sits beside potato chips, meaning thin crisps in the American English used here. The organizer describes musical chairs, pin the tail, a treasure hunt and face painting. An entertainer displays balloon animals. Other ideas include a relay race, karaoke, dance, limbo and tag. The organizer explains the names while respecting different interests and access needs.
